[1/2] Read-only Similar review: perceptual dHash column, on-demand scan, exact-hash groups, tests; [2/2] Similar tab UI, docs, gates, review and publish

impact_assessment.why: The near-duplicate gap is the remaining safe Immich feature: a read-only review needs perceptual hashes but no automatic deletion
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can find re-encoded or resized copies that exact SHA-256 dedupe misses, inspect them side by side, and decide manually
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new dhash column and similar endpoints; dependency: optional Pillow; concurrency: scan writes under the database lock; state: format 12 and on-demand index
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the review read-only with no delete action, skip unreadable files once, test grouping/privacy/migration and HTTP, run 4/4 gates, review the tab in Chromium

[1/2] Similar distance: Hamming radius 8 over cached hashes, connected read-only groups, tests; [2/2] UI threshold text, docs, gates, review and publish

impact_assessment.why: Exact dHash groups miss re-encoded or resized near-duplicates; the read-only review can safely link hashes a few bits apart
impact_assessment.benefits: A more useful Similar review without any delete action, reusing the existing hash cache and no schema change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: grouping changes from exact to connected Hamming components; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: read-only grouping; state: no new columns
impact_assessment.mitigation: A BK-tree avoids an O(n^2) scan, tests cover distance boundaries and privacy, and the UI explains the 8-bit threshold

[1/2] Similar cache: radius-8 cached group tables, background Build groups worker, build API and UI polling, migration/tests; [2/2] gates, UI review and publish

impact_assessment.why: Radius-8 grouping is too slow at page load, so the groups must be precomputed and only read by the Similar tab
impact_assessment.benefits: Responsive Similar page at radius 8 for large libraries, with background progress and no automatic deletion
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new build endpoint and table cache; dependency: stdlib threads; concurrency: background writer under the database lock; state: format 13 and a rebuild that can be interrupted by shutdown
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the page read-only, compute outside the read lock and swap the cache in one savepoint, poll status, test migration/privacy/build, run 4/4 gates and Chromium review

[1/2] Offline photo map: embedded SVG world outline, Places markers and list, read-only filtering, tests; [2/2] gates, Chromium review and publish

impact_assessment.why: Stored GPS points already power the Places rail; a local world outline adds Immich's map view without network tiles
impact_assessment.benefits: A read-only global map for the household with zero tile/CDN dependency, using existing /api/outline data
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new map tab and SVG rendering; dependency: stdlib/server unchanged, browser SVG only; concurrency: read-only; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use fixed equirectangular projection over coarse Places, assert no external tile URLs in tests, review in Chromium, run 4/4 gates

impact_assessment.why: The remaining safe interoperability gap is a sidecar export that never rewrites originals
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can take Harbor tags, GPS and camera metadata into other tools as JSON or XMP, without file mutation or network services
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new ZIP endpoint and two UI actions; dependency: stdlib zipfile/XML only; concurrency: read-only; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every hash through selection.visible, keep filenames collision-safe, test JSON/XMP/ZIP and privacy, gate and review
